title: Gifts Under $100 That Look Expensive
headline: Amazon Gifts Under $100 That Look Way More Expensive Than They Are (She'll Never Know)
seo_title: Amazon Gifts Under $100 for Her: 8 Luxe-Looking Ideas | Looks Like Luxe
description: Amazon gifts under $100 for her that look way more expensive: Sol de Janeiro, Tatcha, an Instax camera, a Stanley tumbler, a NEST candle and more. Eight best-reviewed ideas.
intro: Let's be honest, darling. There is a sweet spot in gift giving, and it lives between 'I grabbed this at the checkout' and 'I took out a small loan.' That sweet spot is under one hundred dollars.

I went through Amazon for the gifts that photograph like a splurge: a cult skincare cream, a perfume mist everyone is obsessed with, a camera that prints tiny photos, a tumbler that has its own fan club. Every one is rated 4.4 stars or higher with thousands of reviews, and every one was under $100 when I checked.
Prices move, especially in the holiday rush, so double-check before you check out. Think of this list as a head start on the entire gifting season.
Let's make her cry (the good kind).
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices and availability live on Amazon and change often.

products.name: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa Hair & Body Perfume Mist
products.best_for: The girl who smells like a vacation and wants to keep it that way
copy: A hair and body mist from one of the most gifted fragrance brands right now, in a bottle that looks great on a vanity.
It has a 4.7-star rating from more than 53,000 reviewers on this listing, which is a lot of people agreeing on one very sweet smell. Pick a scent on the product page.
Verdict: the gift that gets a squeal and a screenshot.

products.name: Fujifilm Instax Mini 12 Instant Camera
products.best_for: The friend who documents every dinner
copy: An instant camera that prints a tiny photo in seconds. It's pretty, playful and very good at turning a night out into a keepsake.
It rates 4.6 stars from more than 1,500 reviewers. Film is sold separately, so tuck in a pack.
Verdict: the most fun thing on this list, and it's still under a hundred.

products.name: STANLEY Quencher H2.0 FlowState Tumbler, 40 oz
products.best_for: A girl whose water bottle is her whole personality
copy: You've seen it everywhere. The 40 oz Stanley Quencher is the tumbler that took over the internet, and it comes in colors that are very giftable.
It has a 4.7-star rating from more than 200,000 reviewers, one of the most-reviewed products on this list.
Verdict: the safest crowd-pleaser, and she'll use it daily.

products.name: TATCHA The Dewy Skin Cream
products.best_for: The skincare girl who deserves a little luxury
copy: A rich moisturizer from a brand that lives in gift guides every holiday season, in a jar that looks right at home on a shelf.
It rates 4.6 stars from nearly 6,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the gift that says you have taste, and the receipt says under $100.

products.name: NEST New York Scented Classic Candle, Bamboo, 8.1 oz
products.best_for: Anyone whose house always smells amazing
copy: A designer candle in a glass jar with a gold-toned lid. It looks like it came from a boutique, not a checkout lane.
It has a 4.6-star rating from more than 1,100 reviewers.
Verdict: the host gift and the girlfriend gift in one.

products.name: O'Bright Seraph Mini Cordless LED Table Lamp
products.best_for: The friend with the aesthetic nightstand
copy: A small cordless lamp with a dimmer and a built-in rechargeable battery, so it works on a nightstand, a dinner table or a patio.
It rates 4.6 stars from more than 1,300 reviewers.
Verdict: a gift that looks like decor and works like a gadget.

products.name: Bigacogo Chunky Knit Throw Blanket, 40x60 inches
copy: A chunky knit throw in a soft neutral that looks like the one in every fall decor photo.
It has a 4.5-star rating from more than 3,000 reviewers.
Verdict: the cozy gift for the girl who hosts movie night.

products.name: REVLON One-Step Volumizer Hair Dryer and Styler
products.best_for: The girl who spends an hour on her hair every morning
copy: A dryer-brush that dries and styles at the same time, which means a salon-looking blowout without the salon bill.
It rates 4.6 stars from more than 350,000 reviewers, one of the most-reviewed hair tools on Amazon.
Verdict: the gift that gives her back twenty minutes a day.

interludes.3: Gifting rule: pick one thing she'd never buy herself. That's what makes it feel like a splurge.
interludes.6: Add a handwritten note. It takes four minutes and wins the whole holiday.

outro: And that's the list: eight Amazon gifts under $100 that look like you tried very, very hard.
If you take one thing from this guide, let it be this. The best gift at this price is the one that feels like a treat. Pick the one that sounds most like her and add a note.
Until the next gift emergency, darling.
